typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MemberID as string,
		Outcome as string,
		PrescriberNPI as string,
		EOCStartDate as date,
		EOCEndDate as date,
		EOCID as string,
		CarrierID as string,
		PrescriberPhoneNumber as string,
		PrescriberFirstName as string,
		PrescriberLastName as string,
		PrescriberAddressLine1 as string,
		PrescriberStateCode as string,
		PrescriberCity as string,
		PrescriberZip as string,
		StateLicenseId as string,
		PrescriberDEA as string,
		PrescriberTaxonomyCode as string,
		Urgent as string,
		MemberFirstName as string,
		MemberLastName as string,
		MemberPhoneNumber as string,
		DesigneeFirstName as string,
		DesigneeLastName as string,
		DesigneePhoneNumber as string,
		DesigneeStateCode as string,
		LanguageCD as string,
		PhoneType as string,
		DesigneePostalCode as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource split(length(PrescriberPhoneNumber) > 10 || length(PrescriberPhoneNumber) < 10 || length(MemberID) > 11 || length(EOCID) > 32, disjoint: true) ~> CheckFieldLength@(FieldTooLong,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
CheckFieldLength@FieldTooLong derive(Errors = (iif(length(PrescriberPhoneNumber) > 10, 'Provider Phone Number Length Too Long, ', '')) + (iif(length(PrescriberPhoneNumber) < 10, 'Provider Phone Number Length Too Short, ', '')) + (iif(length(PrescriberStateCode) > 2, 'Provider State Too Long, ', '')) + (iif(length(MemberID) > 11, 'Member ID Too Long, ', '')) + (iif(length(EOCID) > 32, 'EOCID Too Long, ', '')) + (iif(length(Outcome) > 55, 'Outcome Too Long, ', '')) + (iif(length(PrescriberAddressLine1) > 40, 'Provider Address Too Long, ', ''))) ~> AddErrorsField
AddErrorsField derive(ErrorsWithoutTrailingComma = left(Errors, length(Errors) - 2)) ~> AddErrorsFieldWithoutTrailingComma
AddErrorsFieldWithoutTrailingComma sink(input(
		EOCID as string,
		PrescriberCity as string,
		PrescriberLastName as string,
		PrescriberDEA as string,
		DesigneeStateCode as string,
		PrescriberAddressLine1 as string,
		StateLicenseId as string,
		PrescriberNPI as string,
		PrescriberPhoneNumber as string,
		LanguageCD as string,
		MemberFirstName as string,
		DesigneeLastName as string,
		Urgent as string,
		DesigneePostalCode as string,
		DesigneePhoneNumber as string,
		PrescriberZip as string,
		DesigneeFirstName as string,
		EOCEndDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MemberPhoneNumber as string,
		MemberID as string,
		Errors as string,
		CarrierID as string,
		PrescriberTaxonomyCode as string,
		PhoneType as string,
		Outcome as string,
		EOCStartDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PrescriberStateCode as string,
		PrescriberFirstName as string,
		MemberLastName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		EOCID,
		PrescriberCity,
		PrescriberLastName,
		PrescriberDEA,
		DesigneeStateCode,
		PrescriberAddressLine1,
		StateLicenseId,
		PrescriberNPI,
		PrescriberPhoneNumber,
		LanguageCD,
		MemberFirstName,
		DesigneeLastName,
		Urgent,
		DesigneePostalCode,
		DesigneePhoneNumber,
		PrescriberZip,
		DesigneeFirstName,
		EOCEndDate,
		MemberPhoneNumber,
		MemberID,
		Errors = ErrorsWithoutTrailingComma,
		CarrierID,
		PrescriberTaxonomyCode,
		PhoneType,
		Outcome,
		EOCStartDate,
		PrescriberStateCode,
		PrescriberFirstName,
		MemberLastName)) ~> ErrorFlatFile
